    import sys

    import sys
    import collections

    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0

    n = int(input[index])
    m = int(input[index + 1])
    k = int(input[index + 2])
    index += 3

    groups = [int(x) for x in input[index:index + n]]
    index += n

    acquaintances = defaultdict(set)
    for _ in range(m):
        a = int(input[index]) - 1
        b = int(input[index + 1]) - 1
        acquaintances[a].add(b)
        acquaintances[b].add(a)
        index += 2

    group_members = defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(n):
        group_members[groups[i]].append(i)

    def is_bipartite(graph, start):
        color = {}
        queue = [start]
        color[start] = 0
        while queue:
            node = queue.pop(0)
            for neighbor in graph[node]:
                if neighbor not in color:
                    color[neighbor] = 1 - color[node]
                    queue.append(neighbor)
                elif color[neighbor] == color[node]:
                    return False
        return True

    result = 0
    for i in range(1, k + 1):
        for j in range(i + 1, k + 1):
            if not group_members[i] or not group_members[j]:
                result += 1
                continue

            graph = defaultdict(set)
            for member in group_members[i]:
                for friend in acquaintances[member]:
                    if friend in group_members[j]:
                        graph[member].add(friend)
                        graph[friend].add(member)

            if is_bipartite(graph, group_members[i][0]):
                result += 1

    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
